title: Three takeaways
headline: We propose ฿560 million of net-new marketing; the base case misses F1 (6.6% growth, 34.6% margin), and gates and a response ladder control the spend.

cards.title: Proposal and cost
cards.text: [Proposed] Six objectives, led by Gen Z: ฿2,760m gross ceiling; ฿560m net-new if ฿2,200m is already in costs.

cards.title: What it returns
cards.text: Base case misses F1 (6.6%, 34.6%); ฿560m a year is not repaid by FY2028E. Only the optimistic target meets F1.

cards.title: How it is controlled
cards.text: [Proposed] Five gates, a Plan Office and an Amber, Red, Crisis ladder that freezes, trims or suspends spend.

body.closing: Thank you. We welcome your questions.

notes: On our assumptions, we propose 560 million baht net-new, inside a 2,760 million gross ceiling. Our base case misses F1. The 560 million a year is not repaid by 2028. Only the optimistic case meets F1, a target by definition. We propose gates and a response ladder to control spending. Thank you; we welcome questions.
